description: This file defines interfaces for building responses and events related to live commands in a signal processing system, using a fluent builder pattern. It is part of a command-handling framework for live commands, including steps for configuring responses, events, and final construction of a 'LiveCommandAnswer'.

classes.name: LiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: A fluent interface for constructing immutable LiveCommandAnswer objects through various configuration steps, including setting responses and events for live commands.

classes.name: LiveCommandAnswerBuilder.QueryCommandResponseStep
classes.description: Defines methods for configuring responses for query commands, either with a response function or without response.

classes.name: LiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ModifyCommandResponseStep
classes.description: Defines methods for configuring responses and events for modify commands, with options for response functions and absence of responses.

classes.name: LiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventStep
classes.description: Defines methods for configuring events emitted as a result of command processing, either with a custom event or no event.

classes.name: LiveCommandAnswerBuilder.BuildStep
classes.description: Final step interface for building the LiveCommandAnswer object.

methods.name: withResponse
methods.description: Configures the function for creating a CommandResponse for incoming commands, returning the next builder step.

methods.name: withoutResponse
methods.description: Configures that no CommandResponse should be sent for incoming commands, returning the next builder step.

methods.name: withEvent
methods.description: Configures an Event to be emitted in response to a command, returning the final build step.

methods.name: withoutEvent
methods.description: Configures that no Event should be emitted, returning the final build step.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the final LiveCommandAnswer object based on the configured steps.
